description: Guest GET / login register terms privacy problems — eligible, respect origin TTL
expression: (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not http.cookie contains "sessionid=" and not http.cookie contains "rw_locale=" and not http.cookie contains "rw:markup=" and not any(http.request.headers["rsc"][*] eq "1") and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/login" and (http.request.uri.query eq "" or http.request.uri.query eq "tab=login" or http.request.uri.query eq "tab=register" or http.request.uri.query eq "tab=reset-password")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/register" and http.request.uri.query eq "") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/terms" and http.request.uri.query eq "") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/privacy" and http.request.uri.query eq "") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/problems" and http.request.uri.query eq "")))
